services.description: List of PAM rules (one per line), each defining service-specific authentication/session policy

type.description: Type of PAM rule; must be one of: auth, account, session, password

control_flag.description: Control flag determining how failures/successes are handled (e.g., 'required', 'sufficient', 'requisite', 'optional', 'include')

module_args.description: List of space-separated arguments passed to the module (e.g., ['nullok','try_first_pass'])
